structuredContent.meaning: Changes are close to close over 1, 5, 21, 63 and 252 sessions and from the last close of the year before, as fractions (0.012 is 1.2%); for Treasury yields (quoted in percent) they are percentage points. Sectors are ranked by the month. Dates are each market's last close, so markets abroad and crypto can be a day apart.
limits: Daily closes, not live quotes; intraday moves are not shown.
